dashboard_item.raw_yaml:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Spawned Process
id: f3105aa6-cc0a-432f-aca4-95694188a4e2
status: experimental
description: Detects the spawning of a suspicious process (HOSTNAME.EXE) by PowerShell,
  which is a common technique for executing arbitrary code.
references:
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1082/
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
author: SigmaGen
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1082
- attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: \hostname.exe
    ParentImage|endswith: \powershell.exe
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative script execution
level: high
dashboard_item.wazuh_xml:
<group name="ml_generated,sysmon,">
  <rule id="100149" level="12">
    <if_group>sysmon_event1</if_group>
    <field name="win.eventdata.image" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+hostname\.exe$</field>
    <field name="win.eventdata.parentImage" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+powershell\.exe$</field>
    <description>Suspicious PowerShell Spawned Process [Alert: AI-20261012_133212.894-5c303d8e42fd]</description>
    <mitre>
      <id>T1082</id>
      <id>T1059.001</id>
    </mitre>
  </rule>
</group>
